John, saw nOps scaling off the $30M Series A and showing up at FinOps X 2026.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for nOps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings nOps needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how nOps' reply rate likely compares to other cloud-infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
